fun_facts.text: Nikola Jokic exploded for 88.8 fantasy points in a single game for Hayden.
Luka Doncic exploded for 81.5 fantasy points in a single game for Nick.
Nick's forwards outscored Garrett's by 156 FP this week.
Garrett got some revenge against Nick, who still leads their all-time series 45-21.
Benton got some revenge against Hayden, who still leads their all-time series 39-27.
Hayden has lost 249 games to injury this season -> 55 more than Nick's league-low 194.
Hayden's scoring profile suggests a 8.1-8.9 record, but instead sits at 4-13--a luck index of -4.1, the league's worst. Bad timing and tough matchup draws have defined the season.
